content:
Rita (SRE): Posted the postmortem for the Meridian Dedicated outage — VPC peering flap exposed an on-prem route-policy mismatch causing brief tenant bleed. Link in docs.

ops-bot: New postmortem added: /incidents/1875004322-meridian-dedicated-postmortem.md :rotating_light:

Eli (Platform): Can we capture concrete owners + short deadlines so I can file infra tickets?

Rita (SRE): Action list: 1) Peering health daemon (control + data checks) — owner: Eli — due: 2026-06-06; 2) On-prem policy detector tests + sample fixtures — owner: Hannah — due: 2026-06-13; 3) Dedicated onboarding isolation verification (passive default, opt-in active) — owner: Hannah — due: 2026-05-31; 4) Customer follow-up + NOC one-pager — owner: Diego — due: 2026-05-29.

Hannah (Support): I will build verification script: passive checks (ip route, ip neigh, iptables) + opt-in tcpdump. ETA 4 days.

Eli (Platform): I'll open INF-5299 for the probe work; plan: daemonset on dedicated nodes running a netns-scoped tcp handshake + control-plane state check. Will PR today.

Diego (Customer Success): Drafting comms and the short NOC checklist. Sending to legal; expect ~48h. Customer asked for reproducible safe-checks they can run.

Rita (SRE): Observed this is the 3rd peering-route incident in 10 months. Proposal: monthly "isolation trends" review to aggregate patterns and linter rules. Owner: Rita. Start: 2026-06-02.

QA-bot: Reminder: please add PR/ticket links to the postmortem follow-ups section and mark statuses.

All: :thumbsup:
